Want your own music streaming service?

Kima is a self-hosted music platform for your personal library, with surprisingly powerful music discovery.

It supports Spotify/Deezer/YouTube playlist imports, Lidarr & Audiobookshelf, Subsonic, podcasts, PWA/Android TV, and a “Vibe” system that finds similar music based on audio characteristics.

More details & alternatives: https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/tool.html?id=kima-hub
